text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy, Trai~ner-san.
I'm so very sleepy, YES!"
choice_data_list: So what did you do on your day off yesterday?
What did you do on your day off yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A day-off party with everyone from the dorm!
It was super fun, yes it was♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Since Hishi Ama-san, who always scolds us, went to bed early, it was drinks, singing, and pure chaos, de-SU!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But Hishi Ama-san woke up right after,
and we all got scolded real good! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Taiki Shuttle
is suffering from a lack of sleep.
